enhancements.text: Tyranids model (not Monster) only. The unit can be regenerated twice per phase instead of once.

tyranids-assimilation-swarm.name: Assimilation Swarm
tyranids-assimilation-swarm.ruleText: Command phase: each Harvester unit can regenerate one Tyranids unit within 6" (once per unit per phase). Either heal one model D3+1 wounds or return one destroyed non-Character Infantry model (up to 3 for Endless Multitude units).

stratagems.name: Rapacious Hunger
stratagems.text: Your Fight phase, after a Tyranids unit destroys an enemy unit. It regenerates immediately; a Harvester healing a model heals up to 3 wounds instead of D3.

stratagems.name: Ablative Carapace
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets a Harvester unit in your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase. The Harvester gets Feel No Pain 5+, or 4+ if it's within range of an objective you control.

stratagems.name: Broodguard Impulse
stratagems.text: Any phase, when a Harvester unit is destroyed. For the rest of the battle, Tyranids get +1 to wound against the enemy unit that killed it.

stratagems.name: Secure Biomass
stratagems.text: Fight phase. One Tyranids unit that hasn't fought gains [Lethal Hits] in melee; Harvesters also score critical hits on unmodified 5+.

stratagems.name: Tyrannoformed
stratagems.text: Command phase. A Harvester within range of an objective you control keeps that objective under your control until your opponent takes it at the start or end of a turn.

stratagems.name: Reclaim Biomass
stratagems.text: Any phase, when a Tyranids unit is destroyed. A Harvester within 6" of it regenerates one friendly Tyranids unit within 6".

enhancements.name: Destabilising Predation
enhancements.text: Norn Emissary unit only. Its ranged attacks gain [Anti-Character 2+].

enhancements.name: Synaptoprescience
enhancements.text: Norn Assimilator unit only. 4+ invulnerable save.

tyranids-talons-of-the-norn-queen.name: Talons of the Norn Queen
tyranids-talons-of-the-norn-queen.ruleText: Norn Emissary and Norn Assimilator gain Protean Purpose: once per battle in your Command phase, they can re-pick their Singular Purpose target.

stratagems.name: Tanglestrike Rounds
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, after a Norn Assimilator shoots. One enemy unit it hit gets -2" Move until your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Lesser Prey
stratagems.text: Fight phase, when a Norn Assimilator or Norn Emissary fights. +2 S on melee attacks.

stratagems.name: Catalytic Biofortification
stratagems.text: Any phase, when a Norn Assimilator suffers a mortal wound. It gets Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

dark-angels-tacticus-firestorm-force.name: Tacticus Firestorm Force
dark-angels-tacticus-firestorm-force.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

dark-angels-ironclad-champions.name: Ironclad Champions
dark-angels-ironclad-champions.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

enhancements.name: Flyboss
enhancements.text: Ork Aircraft only. The unit becomes a Character. After it ends an ingress move, friendly Aircraft and Deffkoptas within 6" are riled up until your next turn.

enhancements.name: Impulsive Recon
enhancements.text: Ork Aircraft only. Can make an ingress move in your first Movement phase.

orks-flyboyz.name: Flyboyz
orks-flyboyz.ruleText: Ork Aircraft don't count toward your strategic reserves points. Riled-up Aircraft and Deffkoptas get +1 to hit with ranged attacks.

stratagems.name: Whirligig Evasion
stratagems.text: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit ends a move. One unengaged Deffkoptas unit within 8" can make a normal move of up to D6" (6" if riled up).

stratagems.name: Flyin' Headbutt
stratagems.text: Any phase, when an Ork Aircraft is destroyed, before Deadly Demise. Skip Deadly Demise; instead pick an enemy within 12" and roll 8D6, each 4+ dealing a mortal wound. Then remove your unit.

stratagems.name: Long, Uncontrolled Bursts
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, when an Ork Aircraft or Deffkoptas unit shoots. It re-rolls hit rolls against Fly units.

enhancements.name: Tellyporta Boss
enhancements.text: Mega Armour model only. This unit (not Vehicles) has Deep Strike.

enhancements.name: Wimp-kickaz
enhancements.text: Nobz unit only. Enemy units falling back from this unit must use desperate escape, at -1 to the hazard rolls if this unit is riled up.

orks-bully-boyz.name: Bully Boyz
orks-bully-boyz.ruleText: Your Meganobz and Nobz units get [Sustained Hits 1] on melee attacks.

stratagems.name: Hulking Brutes
stratagems.text: Opponent's Shooting phase, when a Meganobz or Nobz unit is targeted. Attacks with S higher than the unit's T get -1 to wound. For +1 CP more, all ranged attacks against it get -1 to wound.

stratagems.name: Too Arrogant to Die
stratagems.text: Fight phase, when a Meganobz or Nobz unit is targeted. When a model dies before the unit has fought, roll a D6 (+1 if riled up): on 4+ it stays and is removed after the unit fights or at the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Armed to da Teef
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a Meganobz or Nobz unit attacks. Re-roll hit rolls of 1, or all hit rolls if the unit is riled up.

enhancements.name: Boss Boomer
enhancements.text: Wagon unit only. While a Warboss is embarked, this unit gains that Warboss's Intimidating Motivation / Keep Huntin' ability.

enhancements.name: Targetin’ Gizmos
enhancements.text: Wagon unit only. While a Big Mek is embarked, its ranged attacks gain [Ignores Cover], plus [Sustained Hits 1] when riled up.

orks-blitz-brigade.name: Blitz Brigade
orks-blitz-brigade.ruleText: Your Wagon units can re-roll charge rolls. When a Wagon unit Advances, you can treat its Advance roll as a 6.

stratagems.name: Readied Brawlers
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase, after a Wagon unit ends a normal move. Units embarked in it can make an assault disembark move.

stratagems.name: Impending Krunch
stratagems.text: Your Charge phase, after a Wagon unit ends a charge. Every enemy unit engaged with it takes a battle-shock roll at -1.

stratagems.name: Keep It Runnin'
stratagems.text: End of the Fight phase. One unengaged Ork Infantry unit that was eligible to fight and is wholly within 6" of a Transport it can embark in gets in.

dark-angels-phobos-shock-force.name: Phobos Shock Force
dark-angels-phobos-shock-force.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

enhancements.name: Synaptic Strategy
enhancements.text: Tyranids model only. Once per battle, use Rapid Ingress on this unit for 0 CP, even if another unit already used it this phase.

enhancements.name: Tremor Senses
enhancements.text: Tyranids model only. After deployment, redeploy up to three Tyranids units, optionally into Strategic Reserves regardless of limits.

enhancements.name: Trygon Prime
enhancements.text: Trygon only. Gains Synapse, and its melee weapons get +1 S and +1 WS.

enhancements.name: Vanguard Intellect
enhancements.text: Tyranids model with Deep Strike only. The unit can Deep Strike in your first, second or third Movement phase, ignoring mission limits.

tyranids-subterranean-assault.name: Subterranean Assault
tyranids-subterranean-assault.ruleText: Tyranids re-roll hit rolls of 1. When a Burrower (Mawloc/Trygon) arrives from Reserves, place a Tunnel Marker within 1" of it and over 3" from enemies. Units arriving from Reserves can set up within 9" of a Tunnel Marker and over 6" from enemies. Enemy models ending a move within 3" remove the marker. Up to 2 Trygons can be made Characters (so they can take enhancements or be Warlord).

stratagems.name: Swarming Assault
stratagems.text: Your Charge phase. Pick a Tyranid Monster that arrived as Reinforcements this turn: friendly Tyranids within 6" of it re-roll charge rolls this phase.

stratagems.name: Enfilading Emergence
stratagems.text: End of your Movement phase. A Tyranids unit that arrived as Reinforcements this turn gains [Sustained Hits 1] and [Ignores Cover] until the end of your next Fight phase.

stratagems.name: Tunnel Network
stratagems.text: End of your Movement phase. An unengaged Tyranids unit wholly within 9" of a Tunnel Marker is redeployed wholly within 9" of another of your markers and over 6" from enemies.

stratagems.name: Retreat Below
stratagems.text: End of your opponent's Fight phase. One unengaged Tyranids unit, or up to two Burrower units, go into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Replenishing Swarms
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase. A Tyranids unit wholly within 9" of your Tunnel Marker heals one model D3+1 wounds, or returns up to D3+1 destroyed 1-wound models.

stratagems.name: Adaptive Optimisation
stratagems.text: Command phase. A Mawloc or Trygon gains Synapse until your next Command phase.

enhancements.name: Kaptin's Hat
enhancements.text: Infantry Big Mek or Warboss only. After deployment, redeploy up to three Ork Infantry units, optionally into strategic reserves regardless of limits.

enhancements.name: Supa-snazz Dakka
enhancements.text: Flash Gitz unit only. Their Snazzguns gain [Rapid Fire 1].

orks-wreckas.name: Wreckas
orks-wreckas.ruleText: When Breaka Boyz, Flash Gitz or Tankbustas shoot, they re-roll hit rolls of 1 if they or their target are within range of an objective.

stratagems.name: Drive-By Bustin'
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, when an Ork Transport shoots. Weapons fired through Firing Deck get +1 to hit.

stratagems.name: Grab It
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, after an unengaged Breaka Boyz, Flash Gitz or Tankbustas unit shoots. It makes a normal move of up to 6" that must end within range of an objective, and can't charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Gun-Crazy Show-Offs
stratagems.text: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shoots. One Flash Gitz or Tankbustas unit it hit shoots back, but only at that enemy unit.

enhancements.name: Competitive Streak
enhancements.text: Deffkilla Wartrike only. The unit can re-roll charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Smoky Gubbinz
enhancements.text: Speed Freeks unit only (not Aircraft). Targets partly hidden behind this unit's models get the benefit of cover.

orks-kult-of-speed.name: Kult of Speed
orks-kult-of-speed.ruleText: Warbikers count as Battleline. When a Speed Freeks unit Advances or Falls Back, its ranged weapons gain [Assault] this turn and it can still charge.

stratagems.name: Delicious Eating Squigs
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase. Pick a Rukkatrukk Squigbuggies unit: any Ork Infantry units within 3" of it heal 3 wounds each.

stratagems.name: Dakkastorm
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, when a Speed Freeks unit shoots. Its ranged attacks gain [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: Speediest Freeks
stratagems.text: Opponent's Shooting phase, when a Speed Freeks unit is targeted. Attacks against it miss on unmodified hit rolls of 1-3.

enhancements.name: Kill Kommanda
enhancements.text: Infantry Big Mek or Warboss only. While part of an attached unit, the model has Infiltrators and Stealth.

enhancements.name: Throat-slittas
enhancements.text: Kommandos or Stormboyz unit only. Melee attacks gain [Lethal Hits] against non-Monster/Vehicle targets.

orks-taktikal-brigade.name: Taktikal Brigade
orks-taktikal-brigade.ruleText: Stormboyz count as Battleline. Boyz, Kommandos and Stormboyz can still charge after Falling Back.

stratagems.name: While Their Backs Are Turned
stratagems.text: End of your opponent's Movement phase. One unengaged Boyz, Kommandos or Stormboyz unit that started the phase engaged can make a normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Mind Mostly on the Mission
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase, when Boyz, Kommandos or Stormboyz Advance or Fall Back. They can still start an action.

stratagems.name: Dubious Restraint
stratagems.text: Start or end of your Movement phase. One Boyz, Kommandos or Stormboyz unit secures an objective it controls.

dark-angels-assault-brethren.name: Assault Brethren
dark-angels-assault-brethren.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

enhancements.name: Adaptive Biology
enhancements.text: Tyranids model only. Feel No Pain 5+. If it starts a turn damaged, it has Feel No Pain 4+ for the rest of the battle.

enhancements.name: Alien Cunning
enhancements.text: Tyranids model only. After deployment, redeploy up to three Tyranids units, optionally into Strategic Reserves regardless of limits.

enhancements.name: Perfectly Adapted
enhancements.text: Tyranids model only. Once per turn, re-roll one hit, wound, damage, Advance, Charge or save roll for this model.

enhancements.name: Synaptic Linchpin
enhancements.text: Tyranids model only. Friendly Tyranids within 9" of this model are within Synapse Range.

tyranids-invasion-fleet.name: Invasion Fleet
tyranids-invasion-fleet.ruleText: At the start of battle round one, pick one Hyper-adaptation for the whole battle: Swarming Instincts ([Sustained Hits 1] vs Infantry/Swarm), Hyper-aggression ([Lethal Hits] vs Monster/Vehicle) or Hive Predators (critical hits vs Characters gain [Precision]).

stratagems.name: Adrenal Surge
stratagems.text: Fight phase. Up to two Tyranids units in Synapse Range (or one other Tyranids unit) score critical hits on unmodified 5+ this phase.

stratagems.name: Rapid Regeneration
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets a Tyranids unit in your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase. The unit gets Feel No Pain 6+, or 5+ if in Synapse Range.

stratagems.name: Death Frenzy
stratagems.text: Fight phase, after an enemy unit targets a Tyranids unit. Each model that dies before fighting rolls a D6: on 4+ it fights after the attacker, then is removed.

stratagems.name: Overrun
stratagems.text: Fight phase, just before a Tyranids unit Consolidates. It moves an extra 3" if it ends engaged. If it's in Synapse Range and not engaged, it can make a 6" Normal move instead of consolidating.

stratagems.name: Predatory Imperative
stratagems.text: Your Command phase. Up to two Tyranids units in Synapse Range (or one other unit) gain an extra Hyper-adaptation until your next Command phase. It can't be the one picked at the start of the battle.

stratagems.name: Endless Swarm
stratagems.text: Your Command phase. Up to two Endless Multitude units in Synapse Range (or one other) each return up to D3+3 destroyed models.

dark-angels-phobos-shadow-force.name: Phobos Shadow Force
dark-angels-phobos-shadow-force.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

enhancements.name: Efficient Aggression
enhancements.text: Custodes Terminator model only. Once per turn, after an enemy unit shoots in your opponent's Shooting phase, if this unit lost a wound it can surge up to D6+1".

enhancements.name: Mnemo-locked Shrine Cipher
enhancements.text: Custodes Terminator model only. The unit can make an ingress move in your first Movement phase.

custodes-tharanatoi-hammerblow.name: Tharanatoi Hammerblow
custodes-tharanatoi-hammerblow.ruleText: Custodes Terminator units that made an ingress move this turn can re-roll charge rolls. Lions detachment: can't be combined with another Lions detachment.

stratagems.name: Electroexorcist Saturation
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, when a Custodes Terminator unit shoots. Its Ballistus Grenade Launchers have D3+3 Attacks.

stratagems.name: Unleash the Lions
stratagems.text: Your Command phase. An Allarus or Aquilon Custodians unit on the battlefield splits into single-model units, each with a Starting Strength of 1.

stratagems.name: Hardened Resolve
stratagems.text: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a Custodes Terminator unit is targeted. +1 Toughness.

dark-angels-tacticus-attack-force.name: Tacticus Attack Force
dark-angels-tacticus-attack-force.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

enhancements.name: Auric Mantle
enhancements.text: Shield-Captain or Blade Champion only. +2 Wounds.

enhancements.name: Castellan’s Mark
enhancements.text: Shield-Captain only. After deployment, redeploy up to two Custodes units (not Anathema Psykana), optionally into Strategic Reserves regardless of limits.

enhancements.name: From the Hall of Armouries
enhancements.text: Shield-Captain only. Melee weapons get +1 S and +1 D.

enhancements.name: Panoptispex
enhancements.text: Shield-Captain or Blade Champion only. While leading a unit, that unit's ranged weapons gain [Ignores Cover].

custodes-shield-host.name: Shield Host
custodes-shield-host.ruleText: At the start of each battle round you may pick one effect until the next round: Martial Ka'tah melee attacks score critical hits on unmodified 5+, or Martial Ka'tah melee weapons get +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Archeotech Munitions
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase. One Custodes unit (not Anathema Psykana) gains [Lethal Hits] or [Sustained Hits 1] on ranged weapons this phase.

stratagems.name: Arcane Genetic Alchemy
stratagems.text: Any phase, after a mortal wound is allocated to a Custodes model (not Anathema Psykana). Its unit gets Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds this phase.

stratagems.name: Vigilance Eternal
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase. A Custodes Battleline unit (not Anathema Psykana) on an objective you control keeps it under your control until the opponent takes it at the start or end of a turn.

stratagems.name: Multipotentiality
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase. A Custodes unit that Fell Back can still shoot and charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Unwavering Sentinels
stratagems.text: Fight phase, after an enemy unit targets a Custodes Infantry unit (not Anathema Psykana) on an objective you control. Melee attacks against it get -1 to hit.

stratagems.name: Avenge the Fallen
stratagems.text: Start of the Fight phase. A Custodes unit (not Anathema Psykana) below Starting Strength gets +1 melee Attack, or +2 if Below Half-strength.

enhancements.name: Adamantine Talisman
enhancements.text: Custodes model only. Melee weapons get +1 A, S and D.

enhancements.name: Augury Uplink
enhancements.text: Custodes model only. Feel No Pain 5+.

enhancements.name: Honoured Fallen
enhancements.text: Custodes Vehicle only. Aura: Custodes Infantry and Mounted units within 6" re-roll hit rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Veteran of the Kataphraktoi
enhancements.text: Custodes Infantry or Mounted model only. In your Command phase, one Custodes Vehicle or Mounted unit within 6" can shoot after Falling Back until your next Command phase.

custodes-solar-spearhead.name: Solar Spearhead
custodes-solar-spearhead.ruleText: Custodes Vehicles (not Aircraft, not battle-shocked) at Starting Strength get +2 OC. Below Starting Strength they re-roll hit rolls of 1; Below Half-strength they also re-roll wound rolls of 1. Walkers get +2" Move and +1 to Advance and Charge. Up to 2 Custodes Walkers can be made Characters (enhancements/Warlord).

stratagems.name: Wrathful Advance
stratagems.text: Fight phase, just before a Custodes unit Piles In. It can pile in up to D3+3" instead of 3".

stratagems.name: Emperor’s Vengeance
stratagems.text: Fight phase, after an enemy unit targets a Custodes unit. Each model that dies before fighting rolls a D6 (+1 for Walkers): on 4+ it fights after the attacker with 1 wound, then is removed.

stratagems.name: Flawless Construction
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets a Custodes Vehicle in your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase. Attacks with S higher than its T get -1 to wound.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable
stratagems.text: Your Movement or Charge phase. A Custodes Vehicle or Mounted unit can move through terrain this phase.

stratagems.name: Relentless Persecution
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase, after a Custodes Vehicle Advances. It can still shoot this turn; Walkers can also still charge.

stratagems.name: Punishment Inescapable
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase. One Custodes unit gains [Ignores Cover] and ignores all modifiers to BS and hit rolls this phase.

enhancements.name: Da Boss is Watchin'
enhancements.text: Ork model only. Once per battle in your Movement phase, the unit becomes riled up until your next turn.

enhancements.name: Follow Me Ladz
enhancements.text: Ork model only. The unit gets +2" Move.

enhancements.name: Headwoppa’s Killchoppa
enhancements.text: Ork model only. If the unit charged this turn, this model's melee attacks get +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Kunnin’ But Brutal
enhancements.text: Ork model only. The unit can still shoot and charge after Falling Back.

orks-war-horde.name: War Horde
orks-war-horde.ruleText: All your Ork units get [Sustained Hits 1] on melee attacks.

stratagems.name: Mow 'em Down
stratagems.text: Fight phase, when an Ork Vehicle (not a Walker) that charged this turn fights. Melee attacks gain [Cleave 1], or +1 to an existing Cleave value.

stratagems.name: Fungus-Fuel Injection
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase, when an Ork Mounted or Vehicle unit moves. +2" Move.

stratagems.name: Close-Range Dakka
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, when an Ork unit shoots. Ranged attacks gain [Rapid Fire 1], or +1 to an existing Rapid Fire value.

stratagems.name: Hit 'em Harder
stratagems.text: Fight phase, when an Ork unit fights. Melee attacks gain [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: Orks Is Never Beaten
stratagems.text: Fight phase, when an Ork unit (not Titanic) is targeted. When a model dies before the unit has fought, roll a D6 (+1 if riled up): on 4+ it stays and is removed after the unit fights or at the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Breakin' Heads
stratagems.text: Any phase, when an attached Ork Infantry unit becomes battle-shocked. It takes D3 mortal wounds and is no longer battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Extra Sneaky
enhancements.text: Gretchin unit only. -3" detection range.

enhancements.name: Minefield Detail
enhancements.text: Gretchin unit only. Has Scouts 6" while not embarked.

orks-runt-swarm.name: Runt Swarm
orks-runt-swarm.ruleText: Gretchin count as Battleline. Advancing or Falling Back doesn't stop Gretchin from starting an action.

stratagems.name: Scarper!
stratagems.text: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy ends a move within 8" of an unengaged Gretchin unit. The Gretchin can make a normal move of up to D6" (6" if part of an attached unit).

stratagems.name: Infested War Zone
stratagems.text: Any phase, after an enemy unit destroys one of your Gretchin units. Add an identical fresh Gretchin unit to your strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: Grot Shields
stratagems.text: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy targets one of your Ork Infantry units (not Gretchin). Pick a Gretchin unit within 3": each successful ranged hit against the Orks ends its attack sequence and the Gretchin take 1 mortal wound instead.

enhancements.name: Glory Hog
enhancements.text: Beast Snagga model only. This unit can still charge after Falling Back.

enhancements.name: It Came from da Drops
enhancements.text: Beastboss on Squigosaur only. +1 Toughness.

orks-da-big-hunt.name: Da Big Hunt
orks-da-big-hunt.ruleText: Your Beast Snagga units get +1 AP on attacks against Monster or Vehicle units.

stratagems.name: Goaded Into Action
stratagems.text: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shoots. One unengaged Beast Snagga unit that lost a wound can surge up to D6" (re-roll the D6 if riled up).

stratagems.name: Instinctive Hunters
stratagems.text: End of your opponent's Fight phase. One unengaged Beast Snagga unit within 6" of a battlefield edge goes into strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: Where D'ya Fink You're Going?
stratagems.text: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit engaged with a Beast Snagga unit falls back. It must use desperate escape; Monsters and Vehicles make three extra hazard rolls per engaged Beast Snagga unit (-1 if battle-shocked).

dark-angels-tactical-brethren.name: Tactical Brethren
dark-angels-tactical-brethren.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

enhancements.name: Elevated Might
enhancements.text: Winged Tyranid Prime or Tyranid Prime with Lash Whip only. Its melee attacks re-roll wound rolls and get +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Ocular Adaptation
enhancements.text: Winged Tyranid Prime or Tyranid Prime with Lash Whip only. The unit's melee attacks get +1 to hit.

tyranids-warrior-bioform-onslaught.name: Warrior Bioform Onslaught
tyranids-warrior-bioform-onslaught.ruleText: Tyranid Warriors (ranged or melee) units count as Battleline. Tyranid Warriors and Tyranid Primes (lash whip or winged) have a 5+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Synaptic Micronodes
stratagems.text: End of your Movement phase. One Tyranid Warriors unit secures an objective it controls.

stratagems.name: Parasitic Payload
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, when Tyranid Warriors shoot. Ranged attacks gain [Ignores Cover].

stratagems.name: Alien Physiology
stratagems.text: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when Tyranid Warriors are targeted. Attacks with S higher than their T get -1 to wound.

enhancements.name: Enraged Reserves
enhancements.text: Tyranid Monster only. If killed in melee before it has fought this phase, roll a D6: on 3+ it fights after the attacker finishes, then is removed.

enhancements.name: Monstrous Nemesis
enhancements.text: Tyranid Monster only. +1 to wound with melee attacks against Monster or Vehicle units.

enhancements.name: Null Nodules
enhancements.text: Tyranid Monster only. Once per battle, when a psychic attack is allocated to it, it gains Feel No Pain 5+ against psychic attacks for the phase.

enhancements.name: Ominous Presence
enhancements.text: Tyranid Monster only. +3 OC.

tyranids-crusher-stampede.name: Crusher Stampede
tyranids-crusher-stampede.ruleText: Tyranid Monsters get +1 to hit while their unit is below Starting Strength, and also +1 to wound while Below Half-strength. Monster units at Starting Strength that aren't battle-shocked get +2 OC.

stratagems.name: Swarm-Guided Salvoes
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase. One Tyranid Monster unit that hasn't shot gains [Ignores Cover] and ignores all modifiers to its BS and hit rolls this phase.

stratagems.name: Rampaging Monstrosities
stratagems.text: Fight phase. One Tyranid Monster unit that hasn't fought re-rolls hit rolls this phase.

stratagems.name: Savage Roar
stratagems.text: Fight phase, after an enemy unit targets one of your Tyranid Monsters. The enemy takes a Battle-shock test and gets -1 to hit against your unit, plus -1 to wound if it failed the test.

stratagems.name: Massive Impact
stratagems.text: Your Charge phase, after a Tyranid Monster ends a charge. Pick an engaged enemy unit and roll 6D6: each 4+ deals 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Corrosive Viscera
stratagems.text: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, after a non-Fly Tyranid Monster with Deadly Demise dies. Its Deadly Demise mortal wounds trigger automatically, no roll needed.

stratagems.name: Untrammelled Ferocity
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase. One Tyranid Monster unit can move through non-Titanic models and terrain up to 4" tall (and through enemy Engagement Range without ending there). It can go through taller terrain too, but then rolls a D6 and is battle-shocked on a 1.

enhancements.name: 'Ardboyz
enhancements.text: Boyz unit only. The unit has a 4+ save.

enhancements.name: Ferocious Show Off
enhancements.text: Ork Infantry model only. +1 Attack on this model's melee weapons, or +2 if the unit has 11+ models.

orks-green-tide.name: Green Tide
orks-green-tide.ruleText: Boyz get [Sustained Hits 1] in melee. Ork Infantry that charged this turn get [Lethal Hits] in melee against non-Monster/Vehicle targets.

stratagems.name: Unbridled Carnage
stratagems.text: Fight phase, when a Boyz unit that charged this turn fights. +1 Attack on its melee weapons.

stratagems.name: 'ere We Go
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase, when Boyz or Beast Snagga Boyz move. +2 to their Advance roll.

stratagems.name: Mob Mentality
stratagems.text: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase. Pick an Ork Infantry unit of 13+ models: one visible Ork unit within 12" of it automatically passes its battle-shock rolls.

enhancements.name: Blitzboss
enhancements.text: Warboss only. A non-Walker transport carrying this unit gets +2" Move and a 5+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Brutal But Kunnin’
enhancements.text: Warboss only. +1 Damage on this model's melee attacks.

enhancements.name: Da Gobshot Thunderbuss
enhancements.text: Warboss only. Grants this model a special ranged weapon (add its profile to the unit if you use it).

enhancements.name: Morgog’s Finkin’ Cap
enhancements.text: Warboss only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's Movement phase, if unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of up to D6" (re-rollable if riled up).

enhancements.name: Proper Killy
enhancements.text: Warboss only. This model re-rolls hit rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Surly as a Squiggoth
enhancements.text: Infantry Warboss only. Once per battle, at the end of the phase this model dies, roll a D6: on 2+ set it back up near where it died, unengaged, with 3 wounds.

orks-brute-bosses.name: Brute Bosses
orks-brute-bosses.ruleText: When a Warboss is destroyed before its unit has fought this phase, roll a D6 (+1 if riled up). On 3+ it stays on the table and is removed after the unit fights or at the end of the phase.

enhancements.name: Nightforged Battery
enhancements.text: Land Speeder Vengeance unit only. Re-roll rolls for weapon Attacks and hazard rolls.

enhancements.name: Thundercowl Turbines
enhancements.text: Ravenwing Fly unit only. Can make an ingress move in your first Movement phase.

dark-angels-darkflight-pursuit.name: Darkflight Pursuit
dark-angels-darkflight-pursuit.ruleText: Ravenwing Fly units' ranged attacks gain [Ignores Cover]. Your army can't include Astartes units from other Chapters.

stratagems.name: Skyborne Surveillance
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, after a Ravenwing Fly unit shoots. Visible enemies within 6" of it get +3" detection range.

stratagems.name: Wings of Shadow
stratagems.text: Opponent's Shooting phase, when a Ravenwing Fly unit is targeted. It gains Stealth.

stratagems.name: We Are Vengeance
stratagems.text: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shoots at an unengaged Ravenwing Fly unit. That unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Encircling Hunter
enhancements.text: Anathema Psykana model only. After deployment, redeploy up to three Anathema Psykana Infantry units, optionally into strategic reserves regardless of limits.

enhancements.name: Psyk-out Grenades
enhancements.text: Anathema Psykana unit only. Gains Explosives, and when using the Explosives stratagem on an enemy Psyker unit you can re-roll the mortal wound rolls.

custodes-silent-hunters.name: Silent Hunters
custodes-silent-hunters.ruleText: Anathema Psykana units can still start an action after Advancing. They gain Ceaseless Vigilance: in your Shooting phase, null one visible enemy within 12" (a nulled unit has +3" detection range).

stratagems.name: Umbral Prosecution
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, when Prosecutors shoot. Their boltguns gain [Rapid Fire 2] and +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Deathsong Scythes
stratagems.text: Fight phase, when Vigilators fight. Melee attacks gain [Lance], plus +1 A against Psyker units.

stratagems.name: Synchronised Inferno
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, when Witchseekers shoot. Their Torrent attacks gain [Blast 1].

dark-angels-gravis-siege-force.name: Gravis Siege Force
dark-angels-gravis-siege-force.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

enhancements.name: Adept of the Codex
enhancements.text: Captain only. In your Command phase you can activate the Tactical Doctrine for this model's unit only, even if your army already used it.

enhancements.name: Artificer Armour
enhancements.text: Astartes model only. 2+ save and Feel No Pain 5+.

dark-angels-gladius-task-force.name: Gladius Task Force
dark-angels-gladius-task-force.ruleText: At the start of your Command phase, activate one Combat Doctrine (each once per battle) for all Astartes units until your next Command phase: Devastator (can shoot after Advancing), Tactical (can shoot and charge after Falling Back) or Assault (can charge after Advancing).

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets an Astartes unit in your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase. Its attacks against that unit get 1 worse AP.

stratagems.name: Honour the Chapter
stratagems.text: Fight phase. One Astartes unit's melee weapons gain [Lance], plus +1 AP if Assault Doctrine is active.

stratagems.name: Storm of Fire
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase. One Astartes unit that hasn't shot gains [Ignores Cover], plus +1 AP if Devastator Doctrine is active.

stratagems.name: Only in Death Does Duty End
stratagems.text: Fight phase, after an enemy unit targets an Astartes unit. Models that die before fighting stay to fight after the attacker, then are removed.

stratagems.name: Squad Tactics
stratagems.text: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit moves. One unengaged Astartes Infantry or Mounted unit within 8" can make a D6" Normal move (6" with Tactical Doctrine).

stratagems.name: Adaptive Strategy
stratagems.text: Your Command phase. One Astartes unit gets a Combat Doctrine of your choice until your next Command phase, replacing the army's active one, even if already used.

enhancements.name: Ancient Weapons
enhancements.text: Astartes model only. Melee weapons get +2 S, +1 AP and +1 D.

enhancements.name: Deathwing Assault
enhancements.text: Deathwing model with Deep Strike only. The unit can Deep Strike in your first, second or third Movement phase, ignoring mission limits.

enhancements.name: Lord of the Ravenwing
enhancements.text: Ravenwing model only. Re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for the unit.

enhancements.name: Tempered in Battle
enhancements.text: Astartes model only. Aura: Astartes units within 6" can re-roll Battle-shock and Leadership tests.

dark-angels-wrath-of-the-rock.name: Wrath of the Rock
dark-angels-wrath-of-the-rock.ruleText: Attacks against your Astartes Infantry or Mounted units subtract 1 from the wound roll when the attack's Strength is higher than the unit's Toughness.

stratagems.name: Inescapable Justice
stratagems.text: Any phase, after your Oath of Moment target dies. Pick a visible enemy within 12" of an Astartes Character: it becomes your new Oath target until your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Tactical Mastery
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase. One Astartes unit can shoot and charge after Advancing this turn; Ravenwing units can also do so after Falling Back.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets an Astartes unit in your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase. Its attacks against that unit get 1 worse AP.

stratagems.name: Lion’s Will
stratagems.text: Command phase. An engaged Astartes unit gets +1 OC until your next Command phase, and +1 to hit this turn unless it's Deathwing, Ravenwing or a Vehicle.

stratagems.name: Leonine Aggression
stratagems.text: End of your opponent's Charge phase. An Astartes unit within 3" of enemies (or a Deathwing unit within 6") declares and resolves a charge against them, with no Charge bonus.

stratagems.name: Relics of the Dark Age
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase. One Astartes Infantry or Mounted unit gets +2 S on ranged weapons.

dark-angels-terminator-storm-force.name: Terminator Storm Force
dark-angels-terminator-storm-force.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

enhancements.name: Cybork Boosta
enhancements.text: Big Mek or Mek only. +2" Move.

enhancements.name: Dreadherder
enhancements.text: Big Mek only. Within 3" of a friendly Ork Walker (not a Big Mek unit) it has Lone Operative, and in your Shooting phase one such Walker re-rolls hit rolls of 1 for the turn.

orks-dread-mob.name: Dread Mob
orks-dread-mob.ruleText: When one of your Ork Walkers (not Titanic) is picked to shoot or fight, roll 1D6 or 2D6 (re-roll doubles) for bonuses: 1-2 +1 A, 3-4 +2 S, 5-6 +1 AP. If you rolled two dice, the unit takes a hazard roll after attacking.

stratagems.name: Crazed Rampage
stratagems.text: Fight phase, when an Ork Walker (not Titanic) is targeted. When a model dies before the unit has fought, roll a D6 (+3 for a Deff Dread): on 4+ it stays and is removed after the unit fights or at the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Stomping Juggernaut
stratagems.text: Your Movement or Charge phase, when an Ork Walker is picked to move or declares a charge. The unit gains Mobile.

stratagems.name: Dread Power
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase. One Ork Walker unit is riled up until your next turn.

dark-angels-ironstorm-spearhead.name: Ironstorm Spearhead
dark-angels-ironstorm-spearhead.ruleText: Once per phase for each Astartes unit, re-roll one hit, wound or damage roll for a model in that unit.

stratagems.name: Mercy Is Weakness
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase. One Astartes unit gets [Sustained Hits 1] against targets below Starting Strength; Vehicles also crit on unmodified 5+ against them.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets an Astartes unit in your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase. Its attacks against that unit get 1 worse AP.

stratagems.name: Unbowed Conviction
stratagems.text: Command phase. An Astartes unit below Starting Strength can ignore modifiers to its characteristics and rolls (not saves) until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Power of the Machine Spirit
stratagems.text: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit's attacks drop an Astartes Vehicle Below Half-strength. That Vehicle shoots back at only that unit.

stratagems.name: Ancient Fury
stratagems.text: Your Command phase. One Astartes Walker gets +1 Move, Toughness, Leadership and OC and +1 to hit until your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Vengeful Animus
stratagems.text: Any phase, after an Astartes Vehicle with Deadly Demise dies. Its Deadly Demise mortal wounds trigger automatically.

enhancements.name: Chameleonic
enhancements.text: Vanguard Invader model only. The unit has Stealth.

enhancements.name: Hunting Grounds
enhancements.text: Tyranids model only. While it's on the battlefield, each enemy unit set up from Reserves must take a Battle-shock test on a D6 roll of 2+.

enhancements.name: Neuronode
enhancements.text: Tyranids model only. After deployment, redeploy up to three Vanguard Invader units, optionally into Strategic Reserves regardless of limits.

enhancements.name: Stalker
enhancements.text: Vanguard Invader model only. At the start of the battle pick an enemy unit: this model gets +1 to hit and +1 to wound against it.

tyranids-vanguard-onslaught.name: Vanguard Onslaught
tyranids-vanguard-onslaught.ruleText: Tyranids units with this ability can charge after Falling Back. Vanguard Invader units can also charge after Advancing.

stratagems.name: Surprise Assault
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, after a Vanguard Invader unit picks targets. One target takes a Battle-shock test; your unit gets +1 to hit against it, and +1 to wound too if it failed.

stratagems.name: Assassin Beasts
stratagems.text: Fight phase. One Vanguard Invader Infantry unit that hasn't fought gains [Precision] in melee.

stratagems.name: Invisible Hunter
stratagems.text: End of your opponent's Fight phase. Up to two Vanguard Invader units (or one Tyranids Infantry unit) more than 3" from enemies go into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Unseen Lurkers
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets a Vanguard Invader unit in your opponent's Shooting phase. It can only be shot from within 18" (6" if it has Lone Operative); the enemy can re-pick targets.

stratagems.name: Hypersensory Scillia
stratagems.text: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit moves. Up to two unengaged Vanguard Invader units (or one other Tyranids Infantry unit) within 8" of it can make a 6" Normal move.

stratagems.name: Seeded Broods
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase. One Tyranids unit (or up to two Vanguard Invader units) in Reserves can arrive as if it were one battle round later.

enhancements.name: Supa-glowy Fing
enhancements.text: Ork Infantry model (not Weirdboy) only. Its ranged attacks gain [Anti-Infantry 4+], [Devastating Wounds] and a super-hazardous drawback (two hazard rolls per such weapon after shooting).

enhancements.name: Targetin' Squigs
enhancements.text: Big Mek, Bigboss or Warboss only. The unit's non-Torrent ranged attacks get +3" range.

orks-shoota-boyz.name: Shoota Boyz
orks-shoota-boyz.ruleText: Ork Infantry ranged weapons gain [Assault], and +3" range while the unit is riled up.

stratagems.name: Glowin' Dakka
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, when Ork Infantry shoot. +1 AP against targets within 9".

stratagems.name: Never Enough Dakka
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, when Ork Infantry shoot. Ranged attacks gain [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: Kustom Dakka
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, when Ork Infantry shoot. +1 to wound against non-Monster/Vehicle targets.

enhancements.name: Enhanced Voidsheen Cloak
enhancements.text: Anathema Psykana model only. Attacks allocated to it get -1 Damage; attacks from Psykers or battle-shocked models have their Damage set to 1.

enhancements.name: Huntress’ Eye
enhancements.text: Anathema Psykana model only. In your Command phase, one enemy unit within 12" must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Oblivion Knight
enhancements.text: Anathema Psykana model only. While leading a unit, that unit gets +1 to hit, and +1 to wound against Psyker units.

enhancements.name: Raptor Blade
enhancements.text: Anathema Psykana model only. Melee weapons get +1 A, S and D, or +2 instead while engaged with a battle-shocked enemy Psyker unit.

custodes-null-maiden-vigil.name: Null Maiden Vigil
custodes-null-maiden-vigil.ruleText: Aura. In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, enemy Psyker units and enemy units below Starting Strength within 12" of your Anathema Psykana models must take a Battle-shock test, at -1 if Below Half-strength.

stratagems.name: Purgation Sweep
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase. A Witchseekers unit's Torrent weapons get +1 A, or +2 A against Psyker or battle-shocked targets.

stratagems.name: Anathema Blademastery
stratagems.text: Fight phase. A Vigilators unit re-rolls melee hit rolls, and also wound rolls against battle-shocked or Psyker targets.

stratagems.name: Witch Hunters
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase. An Anathema Psykana unit gains [Lethal Hits] or [Sustained Hits 1] but can only target Psyker units this phase.

stratagems.name: Psychic Abominations
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets an Anathema Psykana Infantry unit in your opponent's Shooting phase. It gains Stealth, and Psyker or battle-shocked models can only shoot it from within 12".

stratagems.name: Psy-Chaff Volley
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, after Prosecutors shoot. One enemy they hit is prosecuted until your next turn: Anathema Psykana get +1 AP against it, and if it's a Psyker or battle-shocked it gets -1 to hit.

stratagems.name: Desperation’s Price
stratagems.text: Any phase, after an enemy Psyker uses a targeted psychic ability or makes psychic attacks. With an Anathema Psykana unit within 18", the Psyker takes a Leadership test: it's battle-shocked either way and takes 3 mortal wounds if it fails.

enhancements.name: Admonimortis
enhancements.text: Shield-Captain only. Melee weapons get +3 S, +1 AP and +1 D.

enhancements.name: Fierce Conqueror
enhancements.text: Shield-Captain only. At the start of the Fight phase, its melee weapons gain +2 Attacks for every 5 enemy models within 6".

enhancements.name: Praesidius
enhancements.text: Custodes model only. Has Lone Operative and Stealth.

enhancements.name: Superior Creation
enhancements.text: Custodes Infantry model only. The first time it dies, roll a D6 at the end of the phase: on 2+ it returns near where it died, unengaged, at full wounds.

custodes-lions-of-the-emperor.name: Lions of the Emperor
custodes-lions-of-the-emperor.ruleText: Custodes units (not Vehicles) add 1 to hit and 1 to wound while no other friendly unit is within 6" of them.

stratagems.name: Peerless Warrior
stratagems.text: Fight phase. One Custodes unit that hasn't fought gains [Precision] in melee.

stratagems.name: Swift As the Eagle
stratagems.text: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shoots at a Custodes unit (not a Vehicle). That unit can make a D6" Normal move.

stratagems.name: Manoeuvre and Fire
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase, after a Custodes unit Falls Back. It can still shoot and charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Unleash the Lions
stratagems.text: Your Command phase. An Allarus or Aquilon Custodians unit on the battlefield splits into single-model units, each with a Starting Strength of 1.

stratagems.name: Defiant to the Last
stratagems.text: Fight phase, after an enemy unit targets a Custodes unit. Each model that dies before fighting rolls a D6 (+2 for Characters): on 4+ it fights after the attacker with 1 wound, then is removed.

stratagems.name: Gilded Champion
stratagems.text: Any phase, after a Custodes Character uses a once-per-battle datasheet ability. It can use it one more time (not in the same phase). Once per battle per model.

enhancements.name: Champion of the Deathwing
enhancements.text: Deathwing model only. Its melee weapons gain [Lethal Hits], and score critical hits on unmodified 5+ while within range of your Vowed objective.

enhancements.name: Singular Will
enhancements.text: Deathwing model only. The unit moves an extra 3" when it Piles In or Consolidates.

dark-angels-inner-circle-task-force.name: Inner Circle Task Force
dark-angels-inner-circle-task-force.ruleText: At the start of your Movement phase choose: Defensive Footing (one objective you control becomes your Vowed objective) or Aggressive Push (one or more objectives you don't control become Vowed). Deathwing Infantry add 1 to wound against units within range of a Vowed objective. No Astartes from other Chapters.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets an Astartes unit in your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase. Its attacks against that unit get 1 worse AP.

stratagems.name: Unmatched Fortitude
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets a Deathwing Infantry unit in your opponent's Shooting phase. Attacks with S higher than its T get -1 to wound.

stratagems.name: Martial Mastery
stratagems.text: Fight phase. A Deathwing Infantry unit that hasn't fought re-rolls wound rolls of 1, or all wound rolls while within range of your Vowed objective.

stratagems.name: Wrath of the Lion
stratagems.text: Your Charge phase, after a Deathwing Infantry unit charges. Roll a D6 per model against one engaged enemy (+1 if the enemy is on your Vowed objective): each 4+ deals a mortal wound, max 3.

stratagems.name: Duty Unto Death
stratagems.text: Fight phase, after an enemy unit targets a Deathwing unit. Each model that dies before fighting rolls a D6 (+1 on your Vowed objective): on 4+ it fights after the attacker, then is removed.

stratagems.name: Relic Teleportarium
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase. A Deathwing unit arriving by Deep Strike can set up anywhere more than 6" from enemies, but can't charge this turn.

dark-angels-stormlance-task-force.name: Stormlance Task Force
dark-angels-stormlance-task-force.ruleText: Astartes units can charge after Advancing or Falling Back.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets an Astartes unit in your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase. Its attacks against that unit get 1 worse AP.

stratagems.name: Ride Hard, Ride Fast
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets an Astartes Mounted or Fly Vehicle unit in your opponent's Shooting phase. Attacks against it get -1 to wound.

stratagems.name: Shock Assault
stratagems.text: Fight phase, when an Astartes unit fights. Melee attacks gain [Lance].

stratagems.name: Blitzing Fusillade
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase. One Astartes unit's ranged weapons gain [Assault]; weapons that already had it gain [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: Wind-Swift Evasion
stratagems.text: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit moves. One unengaged Astartes Infantry or Mounted unit within 8" can make a 6" Normal move.

stratagems.name: Full Throttle
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase. An Astartes Mounted or non-Walker Vehicle unit that Advances adds a flat 6" (9" for Mounted) instead of rolling.

enhancements.name: Adrenalised Onslaught
enhancements.text: Tyranids model only. The unit moves an extra 3" when it Piles In or Consolidates.

enhancements.name: Naturalised Camouflage
enhancements.text: Tyranids model only. At the start of battle round one, up to three Endless Multitude units within 9" get cover against ranged attacks for that round.

enhancements.name: Piercing Talons
enhancements.text: Tyranids model only. Critical wounds from the unit's attacks get +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Relentless Hunger
enhancements.text: Tyranids model only. The unit gets +2" Move.

tyranids-unending-swarm.name: Unending Swarm
tyranids-unending-swarm.ruleText: In your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shoots, if it destroyed a model from one of your Endless Multitude units, that unit can surge up to D6".

stratagems.name: Bounding Advance
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase. An Endless Multitude unit that Advances adds a flat 6" to its Move instead of rolling.

stratagems.name: Swarming Masses
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase. An Endless Multitude unit that hasn't attacked gains [Sustained Hits 1]; with 15+ models it also crits on unmodified 5+.

stratagems.name: Teeming Masses
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets an Endless Multitude unit in your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase. Attacks against it get -1 to hit.

stratagems.name: Preservation Imperative
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets an Endless Multitude unit in your opponent's Shooting phase. It counts as under five models for [Blast].

stratagems.name: Unending Waves
stratagems.text: Any phase, when an Endless Multitude unit is destroyed. Add an identical fresh unit to Strategic Reserves (attached Characters don't return). Once per battle.

stratagems.name: Synaptic Goading
stratagems.text: Any phase, before an Endless Multitude unit in Synapse Range surges. Re-roll the surge distance, and it can move toward the nearest objective instead of the nearest enemy.

dark-angels-gravis-linebreaker-force.name: Gravis Linebreaker Force
dark-angels-gravis-linebreaker-force.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

dark-angels-devastator-brethren.name: Devastator Brethren
dark-angels-devastator-brethren.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

enhancements.name: Enhanced Runt-maw
enhancements.text: Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun only. After shooting, one enemy unit it hit gets -1 to Leadership rolls until your next turn.

enhancements.name: Mekwaaagh! Mastermind
enhancements.text: Big Mek only. This unit is always riled up.

enhancements.name: Temperamental Shokka
enhancements.text: Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun only. When picked to shoot you may roll a D6: on 1 the gun gains [Torrent] but the model dies after shooting; on 2-5 the gun gets +1 A; on 6 it gains [Sustained Hits 2].

orks-madcap-meks.name: Madcap Meks
orks-madcap-meks.ruleText: When a Big Mek, Mek Gunz, Morkanaut or Wazbom Blastajet shoots all its attacks at one target, roll a D6: 1 target gets a 4+ invuln while you shoot; 2-3 another enemy within 3" of the target takes D3 mortal wounds; 4 +1 to hit; 5 the target gains Fly and loses cover; 6 the target gets -1 T while you shoot.

stratagems.name: Vindictive Artillerists
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, when Mek Gunz shoot. Pick [Lethal Hits], or [Sustained Hits 1], or both plus [Hazardous].

enhancements.name: Aegis Projector
enhancements.text: Custodes model only. Once per turn, the first failed save for the unit has its Damage set to 0.

enhancements.name: Champion of the Imperium
enhancements.text: Custodes model only. Its Null Aegis or Deadly Unity aura reaches 9".

enhancements.name: Gift of Terran Artifice
enhancements.text: Custodes model only. +1 to wound with melee attacks.

enhancements.name: Radiant Mantle
enhancements.text: Custodes model only. Attacks against the unit from models within 12" get -1 to hit.

custodes-talons-of-the-emperor.name: Talons of the Emperor
custodes-talons-of-the-emperor.ruleText: Anathema Psykana units gain Null Aegis (Aura): Custodes units within 6" get Feel No Pain 5+ vs psychic attacks and mortal wounds. Other Custodes units gain Deadly Unity (Aura): Anathema Psykana units within 6" get +1 to hit.

stratagems.name: Empyric Severance
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets a Custodes unit that has an Anathema Psykana unit within 6", in your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase. Your unit gets Feel No Pain 4+ against psychic attacks and mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Emperor’s Executioners
stratagems.text: Start of the Fight phase. Up to two Custodes units get +1 to wound against enemies below Starting Strength. Two units only if exactly one is Anathema Psykana and they're within 6" of each other.

stratagems.name: Taloned Pincer
stratagems.text: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit moves. Up to two unengaged Custodes units within 8" of it can make a 6" Normal move (two only if exactly one is Anathema Psykana and they're within 6").

stratagems.name: Talons Interlocked
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase. Up to two Custodes Infantry units focus one enemy they can all target: +1 S and +1 AP on ranged attacks, but they can only shoot that unit (two only if exactly one is Anathema Psykana and they're within 6").

stratagems.name: Shield of Honour
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets an Anathema Psykana Infantry unit in your opponent's Shooting phase. Attacks against it are redirected to another Custodes Infantry unit within 6" if that unit is an eligible target.

stratagems.name: Hunt As One
stratagems.text: Start of your Movement phase. Up to two Custodes units can shoot and charge after Falling Back this turn (two only if exactly one is Anathema Psykana and they're within 6").

enhancements.name: Cryptophotaic Camouflage
enhancements.text: Von Ryan's Leapers unit only. -3" detection range.

enhancements.name: Encircling Horrors
enhancements.text: Neurolictor, Lictor or Von Ryan's Leapers only. When an enemy unit ends a move within 8" in your opponent's Movement phase, this unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

tyranids-ambush-predators.name: Ambush Predators
tyranids-ambush-predators.ruleText: Deathleaper, Lictor and Neurolictor units have Deep Strike. Lictors and Neurolictors re-roll hit rolls of 1 against Character units.

stratagems.name: Counterpredation
stratagems.text: Fight phase, when a Deathleaper, Lictor, Neurolictor or Von Ryan's Leapers unit fights. +1 S and +1 AP against hidden units.

stratagems.name: Scanner Gheist
stratagems.text: End of your opponent's Fight phase. One unengaged Deathleaper, Lictor or Neurolictor unit goes into strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: Hypersensory Adaptations
stratagems.text: Start of your Shooting phase. One Deathleaper, Lictor, Neurolictor or Von Ryan's Leapers unit picks a visible enemy within 12": that enemy gets +6" detection range.

enhancements.name: Da Krunch
enhancements.text: Ork Psyker only. Grants this model a special psychic weapon (add its profile to the unit if you use it).

enhancements.name: 'Eadbanger
enhancements.text: Ork Psyker only. Grants this model a special psychic weapon (add its profile to the unit if you use it).

enhancements.name: Warphead
enhancements.text: Ork Psyker only. Psyker level 2, Deadly Demise D6, and can re-roll psychic rolls.

orks-wurrband.name: Wurrband
orks-wurrband.ruleText: Ork Psyker [Psychic] attacks get +1 S, plus +1 S per 5 models in (or embarked in) the unit. Psykers gain two psychic abilities (on a psychic roll of 1 the unit becomes battle-shocked): Roar of Mork (Movement phase: a non-Monster/Vehicle enemy within 12" takes a battle-shock roll at -1 per 10 models in your unit) and Visions of Violence (start of Fight phase: unit gains Fights First).

enhancements.name: Auramite Sarcophagus
enhancements.text: Custodes Walker unit only. Crushing Impact costs 1 CP less on this unit.

enhancements.name: Interred Expertise
enhancements.text: Custodes Walker unit only. Its attacks re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

custodes-might-of-the-moritoi.name: Might of the Moritoi
custodes-might-of-the-moritoi.ruleText: Custodes Walkers get +2" Move and +1 to Advance and Charge rolls. Armoury detachment: can't be combined with another Armoury detachment.

stratagems.name: Prioritised Eradication
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase, when a Telemon Heavy Dreadnought shoots. Arachnus Storm Cannons gain [Rapid Fire 6] and Iliastus Accelerator Culverins gain [Rapid Fire 2].

stratagems.name: Flawless Construction
stratagems.text: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a Custodes Walker is targeted. Attacks with S higher than its T get -1 to wound.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Advance
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase, when a Custodes Walker moves. It gains Mobile.

dark-angels-deathwatch-support.name: Deathwatch Support
dark-angels-deathwatch-support.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

enhancements.name: Power of the Hive Mind
enhancements.text: Tyranids Psyker only. This model's psychic weapons get +1 S and +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Psychostatic Disruption
enhancements.text: Tyranids Synapse model only. Enemy units arriving from Reserves can't set up within 12". Once per battle in round 1 or 2, when an enemy unit is about to arrive from Strategic Reserves, roll a D6: on 4+ it can't arrive this turn.

enhancements.name: Synaptic Control
enhancements.text: Tyranids Synapse model only. Attacks allocated to this model get -1 Damage.

enhancements.name: The Dirgeheart of Kharis
enhancements.text: Tyranids Synapse model only. Aura: enemy units within 9" get -1 Leadership.

tyranids-synaptic-nexus.name: Synaptic Nexus
tyranids-synaptic-nexus.ruleText: At the start of each battle round you can activate one Synaptic Imperative (each only once per battle) for Tyranids in Synapse Range: Synaptic Augmentation (5+ invuln), Surging Vitality (+1 Advance and Charge) or Goaded to Slaughter (+1 to hit in melee).

stratagems.name: Irresistible Will
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase. Pick a Synapse unit that hasn't attacked and a visible enemy within 24": Tyranids within 6" of the Synapse unit re-roll hit and wound rolls of 1 against that enemy this phase.

stratagems.name: Synaptic Channelling
stratagems.text: Command phase. Until the end of the turn, Tyranids within 9" of one Synapse unit count as in Synapse Range.

stratagems.name: Reinforced Hive Node
stratagems.text: After an enemy unit targets one of your Synapse units in your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase. Its attacks against that unit get 1 worse AP.

stratagems.name: Override Instincts
stratagems.text: Your Movement phase. A Tyranids unit in Synapse Range that Fell Back this phase can still shoot and charge.

stratagems.name: The Smothering Shadow
stratagems.text: Any phase, right after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test. A Synapse unit within 12" rolls 6D6: each 3+ deals 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Imperative Dominance
stratagems.text: Your Command phase. One Tyranids unit in Synapse Range gets a Synaptic Imperative of your choice (even one already used) until your next Command phase, replacing the army's active one.

custodes.name: Martial Ka'tah
custodes.text: When a unit with this ability fights, pick a stance until it finishes attacking: Dacatarai (melee weapons gain [Sustained Hits 1]) or Rendax (melee weapons gain [Lethal Hits]).

dark-angels.name: Oath of Moment
dark-angels.text: At the start of your Command phase, pick one enemy unit as your Oath target until your next Command phase. Units with this ability re-roll hit rolls against it. (The extra +1 to wound only applies to armies without Dark Angels or other chapter units.)

orks.name: Waaagh!
orks.text: Ork units with this ability re-roll Advance rolls and can become riled up. While riled up they have a 5+ invulnerable save, their ranged attacks gain [Assault], and they can charge after Advancing. War Cry (once per battle): at the start of a Command phase, every Waaagh! unit is riled up until the end of the next turn.

orks.name: Da Boss
orks.text: If a model with this ability is your Warlord, gain 1 CP at the start of each battle round.

orks.name: Unstable Energies
orks.text: Ork Psykers have a psyker level. Each battle round a Psyker can use psychic abilities whose combined levels don't exceed its psyker level.

tyranids.name: Synapse
tyranids.text: Tyranids within 6" of a friendly Synapse model are in Synapse Range. While in range, they take Battle-shock tests on 3D6 and get +1 Strength on melee attacks.

tyranids.name: Shadow in the Warp
tyranids.text: Once per battle, in either Command phase, if a unit with this ability is on the battlefield: every enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test, at -1 if within 6" of one of your Synapse units.

stratagems.name: Command Re-roll
stratagems.text: Just after you make an Advance, Charge, Damage, Hazard, Hit, Save or Wound roll, or roll for a weapon's number of attacks, for a friendly unit or model. Re-roll it. When rolling several dice together, re-roll one of them (charge rolls are always re-rolled in full).

stratagems.name: Epic Challenge
stratagems.text: Fight phase, just after a friendly Character unit is selected to fight. One Character model's melee weapons gain [Precision] until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Insane Bravery
stratagems.text: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before a battle-shock roll for a friendly unit. That roll automatically passes. Once per battle.

stratagems.name: Explosives
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase. A friendly unengaged Explosives or Grenades unit that's eligible to shoot and didn't Advance picks one of its Explosives/Grenades models and an unengaged visible enemy within 8" of it. Roll six D6: each 4+ deals 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Crushing Impact
stratagems.text: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly Monster or Vehicle ends a charge move. Pick an engaged enemy unit and one of your models engaged with it, then roll D6 equal to that model's T: each 1 deals a mortal wound to your unit, each 5+ deals one to the enemy (max 6 per unit).

stratagems.name: Rapid Ingress
stratagems.text: End of your opponent's Movement phase. One friendly unit in strategic reserves (not Aircraft) makes an ingress move. Not in battle round 1.

stratagems.name: Fire Overwatch
stratagems.text: End of your opponent's Movement phase. One friendly unengaged unit (not Titanic) shoots using snap shooting: one visible enemy within 24", hits only on unmodified 6s, no hit re-rolls, and those hits can't be critical hits.

stratagems.name: Smokescreen
stratagems.text: Start of your opponent's Shooting phase. Until the end of the phase, attacks against your Smoke unit, or against units not fully visible because of it, get the benefit of cover.

stratagems.name: Heroic Intervention
stratagems.text: End of your opponent's Charge phase. One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of an enemy (Vehicles only if Character or Walker) resolves a charge. Leap to Defend: only target enemies that charged this phase. Into the Fray (+1 CP): charge roll capped at 6, and you can target any enemy within 6".

stratagems.name: Counteroffensive
stratagems.text: Fight step of your opponent's Fight phase, just after an enemy unit resolves its attacks. One friendly unit eligible to fight gains Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.
